title: A Circle Run of a tier-gated Journey needs every member of the Circle to hold the tier, not just the member who starts it

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), regression review of #3144 (SCAN-724).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: SCAN-724 made a Circle Run meet the price, tier and seat gates, but checkFreeEnrol runs checkJourneyTier for the caller only, while startRun enrols every active member of the Circle and the learn page reads that enrolment as full access with no tier re-check. A member holding a Space tier could run a tier-gated Journey for a Circle of people who do not, and all of them got it. THE FIX: when the Journey carries a space_tier_id and the caller is not its author or manager, startJourneyRunAction refuses unless every active member passes checkJourneyTier; a failed read refuses.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/(main)/journeys/run-actions.ts','utf8');if(!/await rosterTierCheck\(input\.planId, input\.circleId\)/.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-843: a Circle Run checks the Journey tier for the caller only');process.exit(1)}"
